description: This file defines the OperationFactory class responsible for creating scaffold operation objects (skip, replace, append) based on provided metadata within a Drupal Composer plugin context.

classes.name: OperationFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating scaffold operation objects based on metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a Composer instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a scaffold operation object (skip, replace, append) based on operation data mode.

methods.name: createReplaceOp
methods.description: Creates a 'replace' scaffold operation object, requiring a 'path' in operation data.

methods.name: createAppendOp
methods.description: Creates an 'append' or 'prepend' scaffold operation object, handling optional content files.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if a scaffold file exists and has content.

methods.name: getPackagePath
methods.description: Determines the filesystem path of a package, with special handling for the root package.
